dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Lady Nefer, what brings you here? I'm all out of chips — I'm afraid I can't join you for a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Be that as it may, you're still a skilled player, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, Lady Nefer, but I no longer yearn for... the things I once desired.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: All I seek is a quiet life and to enjoy the things I have.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Very well. I, too, hope you can find true peace, Mr. Viljami.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'm sure I will... No, I'm sure we will all find true peace, someday.
